description: Assess fiber readiness for a lat/lon: distance to a carrier-served facility, number of reachable carriers, and single-carrier risk.

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90, required), e.g. 39.04

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, required), e.g. -77.48

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

radius_km.description: Search radius in km for reachable fiber carriers (default 50, range 5-200)

name: get_fiber_readiness
title: Get Fiber Readiness
